quiz.question_id: Apa tujuan memanggil t.Helper() dalam fungsi test helper?
quiz.question_en: What is the purpose of calling t.Helper() in a test helper function?
options_id: Agar error line number menunjuk ke pemanggil helper, bukan helper itu sendiri
Agar helper bisa dipanggil dari goroutine
Agar helper bisa digunakan di package lain
Agar helper mendapat t *testing.T secara otomatis
options_en: So error line numbers point to the helper's caller, not the helper itself
So the helper can be called from goroutines
So the helper can be used in other packages
So the helper gets t *testing.T automatically

options_id: Mendaftarkan fungsi yang dijalankan saat test selesai (cleanup)
options_en: Registering a function to run when the test finishes (cleanup)
Removing tests from the test suite

options_id: Setup dan teardown yang dijalankan sebelum/sesudah semua test di package
Mendefinisikan test yang harus selalu berhasil
options_en: Setup and teardown run before/after all tests in the package
Replacing the main() function in tests
Defining tests that must always pass
